featureFlags._doc: Runtime feature flags read at Electron startup. Do NOT rely on these for security-critical defaults — a stale version.json on an offline client stays at the shipped values. Security-critical changes must land as code pushes with a version bump.

notes: v1.35.0: Meta capabilities the engine already had, now reachable from the app. NEW IN v1.35.0. (1) SEE YOUR AD SETS AND WHETHER THEY ARE REALLY PAUSED: Merlin can now list every ad set on the account with its parent campaign, its status, its optimization goal, its daily budget and its destination link, and can filter to just the paused ones. This is the check that confirms a staged campaign is genuinely sitting paused before anyone turns it on, and until now there was no way to ask for it. (2) MORE ACCOUNT INVENTORY READS: list the ads inside one ad set with their creative format, inspect one ad set in full so a new one can be built to match a proven winner, list videos already uploaded to the account, list a catalog's product sets and feeds, which is the piece that catalog retargeting setup needs, check that US state names resolve before a geo-targeted build, and pull the tiered warm-audience total. All read-only. (3) THREE NEW ACTIONS: rename ads in bulk so a batch reusing several posts is readable in reporting, change a live ad destination URL when it points at the wrong or a retired page, and create a custom audience such as recent purchasers to exclude from cold prospecting. The URL change and the audience creation both ask for confirmation first. (4) COMPETITOR AD RESEARCH FIXED: searching the Meta Ad Library for a competitor's ads had never worked, because the request was addressed to a name the engine does not answer to. It works now. No user action is required. v1.34.1: Meta bulk ad launches reach the controls the engine already had. NEW IN v1.34.1. (1) NAME A CAMPAIGN THAT DOES NOT EXIST YET: launching a batch into a brand-new campaign name previously failed with "campaign not found" and no way forward, because the option to create it was never exposed to the assistant. You can now ask for a new campaign by name and Merlin will create it (always paused, never spending until you say so). (2) NAME YOUR ADS: each ad in a batch can now carry its own name, so a batch that reuses several different posts is readable in Ads Manager instead of every ad sharing one auto-generated name. (3) ONE SHARED AD SET: you can now ask for a whole batch to sit in a single ad set on one combined daily budget, so Meta concentrates spend on the best creative instead of splitting it evenly, and you can name that ad set. (4) A PAUSE MISUNDERSTANDING FIXED: asking to launch ads "paused" via the status option was silently ignored, so ads could go live when you believed they were staged. Merlin now says so plainly and points to the setting that actually controls it. No user action is required. v1.34.0: deeper Meta reporting, sharper creative guidance, and the v1.33.0 workstreams that had not yet shipped. NEW IN v1.34.0. (1) META AUDIT READS: Merlin can now pull your ad account's change history (who changed what, and when), day-by-day delivery breakdowns, and account health (spend cap, account status, and any disable reason) as read-only insights, with platform rate limits respected on every call. (2) CREATIVE AND OFFER FRAMEWORKS: creative guidance now includes a test-prioritization method (ICE) that feeds the existing statistical Promotion Gate, an offer and copy persuasion-lever catalog, an objection taxonomy for objection-led ads, a named-mechanism method, and a per-platform ad character-limit reference. (3) ROUTING AND DOC FIXES: two mis-routed ad-tool references corrected, a skill-routing gap closed, and a documentation cleanup pass. This release also carries every v1.33.0 workstream, which shipped together below. v1.33.0: Intel Macs, a full design pass, and a security + accuracy sweep. Anchor: 2026-07-05. Five workstreams shipped together. (1) INTEL MAC SUPPORT (mac-compat): Merlin now installs and runs end-to-end on Intel (x86_64) Macs, which had been broken since install two months ago. Per-architecture DMGs (the x64 DMG no longer ships an arm64 Node runtime or arm64-only voice tools), ffprobe bundled on mac, the in-app updater now matches the correct-architecture asset (Intel installs had been handed the arm64 zip), a declared macOS version floor with a clear message below it, an x64 mac smoke test in CI, and the self-update path now verifies the downloaded binary against the release checksums.txt before replacing the running engine (previously it self-replaced with no integrity check). (2) DESIGN PASS (design-polish): an Apple-tier UI sweep with a consolidated design-token system (spacing, radius, shadow, typography, and z-index scales), a unified interaction and motion layer, and copy unification across the app. (3) PERFORMANCE + MONEY-SAFETY (perf-rsi): reports for every window (1 day to 12 months) plus live ad data and the funnel now stream and prefetch in the background so 90-day and 12-month views open instantly; message sends are wedge-proof with no stuck states; the dashboard shares a single orders/charges fetch instead of duplicating it; and several money and metrics accuracy fixes landed across the engine and workers. (4) SECURITY HARDENING (security RSI): a six-auditor adversarial pentest plus independent verification closed the real gaps. The desktop command guard now enforces its destructive-command and app-source-write blocklists from stdin and fails closed (the prior inline hooks read an env variable the SDK never sets, so they silently failed open); the brand-scraper SSRF fence now canonicalizes integer, hex, octal, short-form, and IPv4-mapped-IPv6 addresses before its private-range checks; renderer platform badges escape their class attributes; the main window has a navigation lock; OAuth entropy generation fails fast on a crypto/rand error; the wisdom worker fails closed by default when its signing key is unset; and CSP plus nosniff headers are now consistent across landing and wisdom responses. (5) CREATIVE HARNESS (corpus): the creative-generation corpus now fails loudly on fal generation errors and paces reference uploads. No user action is required for any of this.
whatsNew: See every ad set on your Meta account, with its campaign, status, budget and destination, and filter to just the paused ones. This is how you confirm staged campaigns really are paused before anything goes live.

New reads for the rest of your account: the ads inside an ad set, a full ad set inspection for cloning a winner, uploaded videos, catalog product sets, geo-targeting checks and your warm-audience total.

Rename ads in bulk, change a live ad's destination URL, and create custom audiences such as recent purchasers to exclude from prospecting. Competitor Ad Library research also works for the first time.
